purpose: Operational rules for jurisdiction, authority, semantics, conflict, protected-subject, evidence, temporal and provenance resolution without universal-compliance overclaim.

resolve_jurisdiction.rule: Never collapse multiple plausible jurisdictions to one without an applicability basis. A repository location or author nationality alone does not establish the governing law of every use.

resolve_authority_hierarchy.rule: Constitution/law/regulation/treaty/contract/standard/RFC/guideline must remain distinct. Technical or voluntary material becomes binding only through an applicable legal, contractual, procurement or certification route where demonstrated.

semantic_contextualize.rule: Token presence alone does not establish harassment, illegality, consent, discrimination or acceptability. Preserve contextual ambiguity when evidence is insufficient.

cross_cultural_semantic_diff.rule: Never promote cultural similarity to legal equivalence without authoritative mapping for the jurisdictions involved.

detect_normative_conflict.rule: Do not average incompatible obligations. First test whether both atoms are simultaneously applicable; then evaluate hierarchy, lex specialis, lex posterior, contractual scope and rights balancing as jurisdiction permits.

protected_subject_gate.rule: Child/adolescent status triggers dedicated protection analysis where applicable; best-interests and child-rights principles are not encoded as an automatic override of every competing right or rule.

evidence_and_conformance_gate.rule: Citation, README text, badge or checklist does not prove conformance. PASS requires scope-specific evidence tied to the exact requirement/version.

temporal_validity.rule: A newer upload timestamp never makes old normative bytes current. Temporal status follows the issuing authority/source record.

provenance_chain.rule: Every promoted conclusion must be reversible to an authoritative source plus the repository observation that triggered applicability. Missing edges remain TOKEN_VAZIO.

anti_regression_invariants: internal ethical policy != universal conflict-of-laws rule
child protection requires dedicated gate and cannot be silently weakened
negative evidence and contradictions are append-only
